title: One Sauna Session Sends White Blood Cells Surging
paragraphs: Scientists in Finland studied the sauna. Fifty-one adults took part. They sat in a hot sauna for 30 minutes.
The scientists took blood from them. After the sauna, they had more white blood cells. White blood cells help the body fight germs.
The change was short. After 30 minutes, the numbers went back to normal.
